field_text_formatted.value: A checkbox is the third option, on a new settings form at Configuration > Web services > Druxt. It grants read where administer filters grants write, and it grants it to everyone holding access druxt resources instead of to one trusted account. List editor--editor and the frontend reads the toolbar and builds from it; change the toolbar in Drupal and the editor changes, with no rebuild: 10 buttons for basic_html, 16 for full_html.
